neighbors.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
neighbors.label: human
neighbors.text: We show that retrieval can be practically implemented using dense representations alone, where embeddings are learned from a small number of questions and passages by a simple dual-encoder framework.

neighbors.title: A Survey of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Methods
neighbors.label: ai
neighbors.text: This survey reviews retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, covering document indexing, query rewriting, and fusion strategies across open-domain QA and long-form summarization tasks.

neighbors.title: Learning Sparse Neural Networks Through L0 Regularization
neighbors.label: human
neighbors.text: We propose a practical method for L0-norm regularization that allows efficient learning of sparse neural networks with competitive accuracy on image classification benchmarks.
